subcategory_text: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-09, PM-18, PM-28, PM-30, RA-03
implementation_examples: Define and communicate guidance and methods for identifying opportunities and including them in risk discussions (e.g., strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats [SWOT] analysis)
Identify stretch goals and document them
Calculate, document, and prioritize positive risks alongside negative risks
assessment_objectives: Determine whether strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions.

Determine whether activities are conducted to define and communicate guidance and methods for identifying opportunities and including them in risk discussions (e.g., strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats [SWOT] analysis).
Determine whether activities are conducted to identify stretch goals and document them.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
